highlights: Focused on Large Climate Datasets, CMIP6 Evaluation, NEX-GDDP project, ISIMIP project, ScenarioMIP, and climate extremes.
Automated the analysis of CMIP6 climate models in R by building linked script pipelines, slashing computation time from 1-2 months to only 1 week.
Used R packages HydroGOF and Rstat to calculate statistical metrics; applied sf, terra, and tidyverse for high-quality spatial data visualization.
Calculated and evaluated extreme weather indices using the Climpact package in R.
